notes.title: Quick Match Mode
notes.content:
[img]http://www.epicarenagame.com/fileadmin/docs/epicarena/banners/epicarena_quick_match.jpg[/img]
We are continuously gathering player's feedback since the Steam release in May and one thing that has come up often is that regular PvP matches lasts too long. 

To make the game faster we have added an exciting new game mode that introduces short team decks - each short deck contains 11 cards - one of each kind. Also for this game mode we created a bunch of small game boards too!

Short decks and small game boards make an average match last 5–7 minutes! It's perfect for players who enjoy fast and furious gameplay.

Give it a try and let us know what you think!

notes.title: No more Powercards for premium currency
notes.content:
[img]http://www.epicarenagame.com/fileadmin/docs/epicarena/banners/Bossters_coins.jpg[/img]
After the Steam release we received some negative feedback from players. Based on that we have decided to make Power Cards available only for Gold coins and there won't be and option to purchase them with Crystals. Gold coins can not be purchased for real money and this is the true in-game currency that players can earn only by playing the game. The more and better you play , the more Gold you earn!

Players can spend Crystals only for purchasing Team Decks, Uniform colors and Spyglass, which is available for Gold too since May 6, 2015.

For players who have already purchased Crystal packs and/or purchased all non-consumable content (Decks, Spyglass, Avatars and Uniform colors), please PM us with your username and Steam ID. We will convert your Crystals balance to Gold with a really good rate of 1:200.
